bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.request import Request,urlopen
from tumblrkit.telegram_bridge_client import LocalTelegramOwner
query="""SELECT topic_id FROM posting_topics WHERE purpose='announcement'
 AND enabled=TRUE AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND verified_by IS NOT NULL
 AND (title ~* 'test|テスト|検証|動作確認') ORDER BY topic_id LIMIT 1"""
topic=subprocess.check_output(["docker","exec","deploy-postgres-1","psql","-U","gace","-d","gaybbs","-Atc",query],text=True,timeout=12).strip()
if not topic.isdecimal():
 print("NO_DEDICATED_TEST_TOPIC;_NO_PUBLIC_SEND")
 sys.exit(26)
key=Path.home()/".config/tgtumbler/bridge/owner-token"
owner=LocalTelegramOwner(key)
token=(Path.home()/".config/tgtumbler/tumblr-operation-app/tumblr-app-access-token").read_text().strip()
def app(data):
 request=Request("http://127.0.0.1:8081/assistant",json.dumps(data,ensure_ascii=False).encode(),headers={"Content-Type":"application/json","Authorization":"Bearer "+token},method="POST")
 with urlopen(request,timeout=22) as r:return json.load(r)
msg="🧪 Tumblr→Telegram 接続テスト（運営の技術確認・返信不要）"
preview=app({"selected_action":"telegram.publish_announcement","selected_target":topic,"message":"本文: "+msg})
assert preview["state"]=="confirmation_required" and preview.get("request_id"),"PREVIEW_FAILED"
operation=preview["request_id"]
result=app({"confirm":True,"request_id":operation})
lookup=owner.transport({"action":"lookup","destination":topic,"operation_key":operation})
assert lookup.get("verified") is True and lookup.get("message_id"),("OWNER_LEDGER_NOT_SENT",result.get("state"))
message=lookup["message_id"]
readback=owner.transport({"action":"readback","destination":topic,"message_id":message})
assert readback.get("verified") is True,("OWNER_LEDGER_NOT_VERIFIED",readback)
assert result.get("state")=="completed" and result.get("executed") is True,("TUMBLR_CONFIRM_NOT_COMPLETED",result.get("state"))
print("REAL_TELEGRAM_POST_AND_OWNER_LEDGER_READBACK=PASS")
PY
